- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided general tips for correcting mistakes in model kits, including staying calm, assessing the situation, identifying the type of mistake, evaluating severity, consulting instructions, using the right tools, removing excess material, filling gaps, realigning parts, blending and smoothing, learning from mistakes, and being patient.
- [EVENT] User mentioned they were sorting through parts and instructions on the first day of working on the model kit.

- [EVENT] User described a specific mistake where they applied too much glue while trying to glue the hull together, causing parts to shift and creating a gap.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided specific steps to fix the gap, including assessing the situation, removing excess glue, letting it dry, preparing the area, applying filler material, clamping parts together, sanding and smoothing, and blending with the surrounding area.
